header: - Audited commit: `f79bf59` (source). HEAD `3495524` only adds evidence files (validation/, review/): `git diff f79bf59 HEAD -- src tools tests maps routes assets` is empty. The working tree was clean at the start; the only path this audit added is `review/gate-2/audit/`.

- Auditor: independent and adversarial. Nothing under src/, tools/, tests/, maps/, maps-src/, routes/, assets/, the root docs, package.json or the evidence files was modified. Mutation experiments, the map recompile, `validate` and `vite build` were run in copies under the scratchpad.

- Status labels: CONFIRMED = reproduced by a script or command in this audit; PLAUSIBLE = strong code-reading evidence, not reproduced. Every CONFIRMED finding names its reproduction script under `repro/` (plain `node`, run from the repo root); `repro/t0*.mjs` scripts are supporting checks whose results are in the 'found TRUE' list.
method: - Read AGENTS.md, PRODUCTION_LOG.md, TESTING.md, GAME_VISION.md, ART_BIBLE.md, design/EPISODE1.md, review/gate-2/README.md and known-defects.json, then all of src/engine, the game shell (main.js, ui.js, testhook.js), the audio event map, view.js, the maps' sources, verify-map/validate/gate2-bundle/browser-check, and the tests that guard the Gate 2 kit.

- `npm test` -> `tests 220 / pass 220 / fail 0` (119 s). `npm run browsercheck` was NOT run (per brief); the committed validation/browser-check.json was read and cross-checked (89 checks, all ok, commit f79bf59, dirtySource false, map shas equal the sha256 of the map files, 10 route pairs identical).

- Node probes against the real modules (`repro/`): exit gating (a01*, a02), Warden knockback (a03), degraded-player runs and ammo margins (a04*), README/evidence cross-check (a05), validator fuzz (a06), save/load fidelity and hostile saves (a07*, a08), splash through walls (a14), random-input fuzz of every map (t06), funicular state space (a11*), campaign chain with carry-over (a16), texture wrap seams (a12), physical pickup reachability (t01), trap cells (t02), spawn overlaps (t03), chamber ammo (t04), unfired triggers (t05).

- Mutation testing: 22 hand-made one-line mutations of the sim (defs.js, world.js, script.js, nav.js) applied one at a time to a scratchpad copy, each followed by the whole `node --test` suite (results in the table under 'Test quality' below).

- In-app browser on the already-running dev server (localhost:5173, the user's `npm run look` process, untouched): A17 and A18 were reproduced with the game's real title/pause buttons plus the dev test hook to jump to a map. rAF is suspended in that pane, so the real-time loop and the ending timer could not be driven there. NOTE: the reproduction cleared localStorage for the localhost:5173 origin in that pane (test saves and any settings stored there).

- Also: `vite build` into a scratchpad outDir (production bundle builds; no `__GAME_TEST__`/`setup_*` strings in it), `node tools/mapkit/compile.mjs` for all eight maps-src in a scratchpad copy (byte-identical to the committed maps), `node tools/validate.mjs --status` in a scratchpad copy (68 slots, 9 AGENT_VERIFIED), reading review/gate-2/screenshots as images.
true: `npm test` really is 220/220 (README, test-results.json, TESTING is the stale one).

validation/browser-check.json: 89 checks, all ok, stamped f79bf59 with no dirty source; every map evidence file, the audio evidence and the browser check carry the same commit; every map sha and canonical-route sha in the evidence equals the current file's sha256 (nothing stale).

README table: enemy counts, bot seconds (normal) and the normal-difficulty passive-runner column match validation/maps/*.json exactly (the damage columns are 3-seed means, see A05). `validation/campaign.json` counts (9 AGENT_VERIFIED, 59 PLANNED of 68; 36 + 32 slots; secret topology) are what `validate` derives.
The committed maps are exactly what `maps-src/*.level.mjs` compile to (8 of 8 byte-identical); ART_BIBLE's Gate 2 seed table matches recipes_g2.js and assets/baked/manifest.json (7101-8301).

The sim is deterministic in the ways it claims: no Math.random/Date/performance in src/engine (the game shell uses them for the new-game seed and save timestamps), state hashes of two runs with one seed are identical, and the browser-vs-Node route parity holds (caveat: it compares one JavaScript engine with itself, and the routes are stepped through the test hook in manual mode, so it is a low-information check).

Save/load of the NEW Gate 2 state is faithful: tone pulses in flight, a mid-channel Sexton, a mid-charge Warden, a revived enemy, a sector mid-move and the lights level all round-trip through makeSave -> JSON -> parseSave -> loadWorld and then play identically for 300-900 ticks (a07b). The only divergence found is the nav-cache effect in A07.

The route bot only reads world state and acts through InputState (no writes to the world anywhere in src/engine/bot.js), and its boss op uses only sim-visible information (pulses, windups, LOS, its own cover search).

Content soundness holds: every pickup on every map is physically collectable with the real collision code, in at least one sector state (t01); no map has a cell the player can reach but not leave (t02, including the M05 funicular state space in a11); enemy/spawn placements overlap no collider that matters (t03); every trigger, switch, message and closet fires on the canonical routes except M05's `car-down` lever (t05); 27 random-input fuzz runs of 4000 ticks (t06) produced no exception, no NaN/Infinity and no player inside a wall (one observation: a corpse that lay in a doorway when the door auto-closed was later raised by a Sexton and stood embedded in the closed door cell, un-hittable and stuck until the door is opened; cosmetic).

M02-M05 gates hold: a fighting bot ordered straight to the exit is refused on M01, M02, M03, M04 (main exit), M05 and M06 (a02). Secret topology M04 -> S01 -> M05 is what the manifest and tests/flow.test.js say.

Audio: every event emitted by world.js and script.js has a sound or is declared silent (checked by hand; the automatic test only scans world.js, see A21); audio QA evidence is 54 effects, peak 0.93, stamped f79bf59.

Scope/process: nothing beyond Episode 1 exists (no C1E2+ maps, no extra assets), the 68-slot manifest is intact, dependencies are pinned exactly with a lockfile, all art is p5-baked and no external resources are loaded (no http(s) references in index.html or src), no secrets are tracked, the production build contains no test hook, and M01 is byte-identical since Gate 1 (map sha and routes unchanged).
limits: Did not run `npm run browsercheck`, the bake, audio QA or any headless-Chrome tool (per brief); nothing was listened to (audio) and nothing was measured on a real GPU. The 60 FPS target and every subjective claim (readability, feel, telegraphs, look) are outside what this audit can establish; screenshots were judged by eye only.

Human validity (A04, A16) was probed by degrading the bot (less ammo, aim tremor, campaign carry-over), not by people; the direction of the result is informative, the exact thresholds are not a measurement of human play.
The mutation set is 22 hand-picked mutations, not a full mutation analysis; survivors show missing assertions, killed mutants do not prove a rule is fully covered.

A17/A18 were reproduced in the dev build via the in-app browser pane with the test hook selecting the map; the real-time rAF loop and the end-of-level timer could not run there (page hidden), so the 'finish the episode, then Back to title, then Normal' variant of A17 is supported by code reading and by the identical mechanism (g.mapId), not by a played-through run.

Not audited in depth: the painted-atlas recipes and bake determinism (Gate 0/1 territory), the music/ambience synthesis code, the look demo (`src/look`), bindings/settings modules (covered by the Gate 1 audit), and the post-process shader.
The draw-call ceilings and budget claims were assessed from the committed evidence and code only.
